Key Features & Advantages

Spring-Loaded Safety Cam

Maintains clamping grip on the plate even when tension is momentarily relieved.

Special Hardened Teeth

Heat-treated cam and pivot pad bite firmly into structural steel plates.

180° Plate Turning Capability

Allows lifting and rotating steel plates from horizontal to vertical orientation.

Standards & Compliance

EN 13155 European Standard

Lifting attachments standard.

CE Certified

Batch tested with serial number traceability.

Product Overview

Europull Vertical Plate Clamps provide dependable gripping and lifting for structural steel fabrication yards, shipyards, and steel service centers.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp are available?

The Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp is available in 5 models: EP-VLC01, EP-VLC02, EP-VLC03, EP-VLC05, EP-VLC10. WLL (Tons) ranges from 1.0 Ton to 10.0 Ton. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp cover?

The Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp covers 1t - 10t.

Which standard does the Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp comply with?

The Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp is manufactured to EN 13155.

What jaw Opening does the Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp have?

The Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp's jaw Opening: 0 to 100 mm (Plate Thickness).

What lock Mechanism does the Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp have?

The Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp's lock Mechanism: Positive Spring-Loaded Safety Lock Lever.

What plate Hardness does the Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp have?

The Europull Vertical Lifting Clamp's plate Hardness: Suitable for Plates up to 37 HRC (345 HB).
